resources.string: Notifications reach this phone through ntfy, a free app. Install ntfy on this phone, then subscribe to your private topic below.
Anyone who knows the topic can read the notifications, so it stays hidden here. They carry only a short fixed notice, never your messages or code.
The ntfy app is not installed, so the link could not open. Install ntfy, then tap Subscribe in ntfy again.
A small service on the server of this connection watches opencode and sends the notifications. It needs python3 3.9 or later.
The service and its settings are removed from the server, and notifications stop. You can install it again at any time.
Sends one notification from the server to your topic, to try the whole way to this phone.
The ntfy server took the test notification. It should show up in the ntfy app shortly.
ntfy.sh is used unless you run your own ntfy server.
The address must start with https://.
Enter only the address, like https://ntfy.example.com, without a path or a password.
An installed service keeps its old server until you install it again.
